tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Submit a trip the user confirmed. Return a hosted payment link for the confirmed deposit or full fare. A deposit saves the card for the automatic balance charge. Payment reserves the ride, subject to availability. Sprinter hourly and one-way are requests. For a payable trip, pass the same trip field

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
